prompt: Your friends are arranging to arrive together and take a group photo before school, and you realise one friend from the group has not been told about it. What response best includes them fairly?

options.text: Tell the group you have noticed they are missing and suggest adding them before plans are final
Say nothing and enjoy the photo as planned
Tell the left-out friend afterwards that it was not your idea
Skip the photo yourself in protest without telling anyone why

explanation: Speaking up before the plan is final gives the group a chance to fix the oversight without blame and stops the friend feeling deliberately excluded.
